note: Received documents (SW-IMP-1). Only the documents were imported; see PROVENANCE.md.

received.cover: SmartWeld plant isometrics: provenance 139 drawings on 240 sheets, covering 203 of the 203 pipe lines in the plant. Each line has its own drawing, except small vents and drains, which are drawn on the sheet of the line they come off. Source: SmartWeld's clean-room 3D model, https://github.com/adamrobichaud55-design/Refinery, branch ccr-b60fa7fe-eo6rly, commit c35ea3396121 (smartweld/public/groundtruth). Its export is copied unchanged into the generator's repository; SOURCE.json fingerprints every file (SOURCE.json SHA-256 773a30e37cefa94b...). Drawn by SmartWeld's isometric generator, commit 27bc863867ee, on 2026-11-01. Every sheet was checked against the export as it was drawn: positions, printed dimensions and coordinates, the bill, and every item, weld and support linked to its tag in the model. What the drawings contain: only the model's own data (lines, parts, lengths, welds, supports, bill rows), drawn with SmartWeld's own symbols (the owner's freehand sketches and own-words descriptions, SPEC.md). No published dimension table, catalogue, standard figure, symbol library or third-party drawing was used to make them. Rendered with resvg and ReportLab (permissive licences); text in DejaVu Sans (Bitstream Vera licence). Confidential: SmartWeld's own work. Nothing else from the generator's repository or working sessions accompanies this file. Record its receipt, with this file's SHA-256, wherever it is imported. Part 1 of 3: sheets 1 to 80 of 240 (pages 2 to 81 of this file). Split from SmartWeld-plant-isometrics-27bc863.pdf (SHA-256 16d365ec5ad4469a...) without other change, so that each part can be uploaded; the three parts together are the whole set.
